decision.interpretation: Use already-planned paired parent-cluster95%CI and effect sizes; no new margin, sweep or prefix scores. CI crossing0 is no demonstrated positive contribution, not proven equality. Root evaluates strict removal comparison and direct shared-corrected-box alternative together; disclose temporal and tail tradeoffs. If Vid also provides no clear first-auxiliary-DP benefit, adopt the user-specified shared-corrected-box ROI alternative, not choose the best among multiple ROI variants from full results.
decision.mixed_evidence: Explicitly report any clearly positive strict-removal effect or clear shared-corrected-box degradation before claiming condition met; no automatic result hiding.
